evidenceBoundary: The built single-file Bookmarks UI is rendered in Chromium against an in-memory local window.ryu Space/storage/UI bridge fixture. This map covers form submission, both HTML import entry points, topic filtering, favorite/edit/delete persistence, tooltip hover/focus descriptions, retry, and empty-view recovery. File selection uses local HTML fixtures; the suite does not contact live Core, a browser profile, semantic embedding providers, or external services.

assertions.testTitle: submits the add form from the URL field and reads back the saved bookmark
assertions.assertionName: Keyboard submission creates a complete Space document and it remains available after reload.
assertions.assertionMarker: The form keyboard submission persists the complete bookmark through Space.

assertions.testTitle: imports from both visible entry points and stores nested folders in Space
assertions.assertionName: The empty-library Import HTML action opens file selection and imports every nested link.
assertions.assertionMarker: The empty-state import action selects a file and persists every parsed link.

assertions.testTitle: retries the initial Space read after a temporary local failure
assertions.assertionName: Try again repeats the failed initial Space operation and restores the empty library.
assertions.assertionMarker: Retry makes a second Space request and clears the initial bootstrap error.

assertions.testTitle: resets an empty semantic-search view to the full saved library
assertions.assertionName: Reset view clears a zero-result query and restores the complete local library.
assertions.assertionMarker: Reset clears the query and restores every locally saved bookmark.

assertions.testTitle: topic controls filter the saved collection and restore it when toggled
assertions.assertionName: Selecting a topic shows only matching saved records; toggling it off restores all records.
assertions.assertionMarker: Toggling the topic control changes the rendered collection and restores all saved rows.
